dogecoin.text:
What are memecoins ?

Meme coins are cryptocurrencies inspired by internet jokes. Dogecoin 🐶, for instance, stems from the Doge meme featuring a Shiba Inu. While not taken seriously, they gain momentum as people join in for the humor.
